# Spellkit recipes

This page contains small, complete programs that run with the Spellkit console. For a language tour, see the [overview](Overview.md); for syntax details, see the [grammar reference](Grammar.md).

Build the Release console once from the repository root:

```powershell
.\scripts\build-local.ps1 -Configuration Release
```

## Collections and data transformation

Filters a collection and formats the resulting values. It demonstrates arrays, comprehensions, loops, and string formatting.

```swift
let scores = [91, 84, 95, 76]
let passed = [score for score in scores when score >= 90]

for score in passed {
    print(fmt("passed: {0}", score))
}
```

Run it with:

```powershell
dotnet .\bin\spk.dll .\Examples\Language\01-collections.kit -nologo
```

Source: [01-collections.kit](../Examples/Language/01-collections.kit)

## Pattern matching

Classifies values with `match`, including literal, range, and fallback patterns.

```swift
func describe(value) => match value {
    nil => "missing",
    0 => "zero",
    1..9 => "single digit",
    _ => "other"
}

print(describe(7))
print(describe(20))
```

Run it with:

```powershell
dotnet .\bin\spk.dll .\Examples\Language\02-patterns.kit -nologo
```

Source: [02-patterns.kit](../Examples/Language/02-patterns.kit)

## Types and traits

Defines a value type and a trait implementation, then uses the resulting method from ordinary script code.

```swift
struct Point { x, y }

trait Displayable {
    func Describe()
}

impl Point with Displayable {
    func Describe() => fmt("({0}, {1})", this.x, this.y)
}

let point = Point(3, 4)
print(point.Describe())
```

Run it with:

```powershell
dotnet .\bin\spk.dll .\Examples\Language\03-types-and-traits.kit -nologo
```

Source: [03-types-and-traits.kit](../Examples/Language/03-types-and-traits.kit)

## Iterators

Declares an iterator function with `yield` and consumes it with `for`.

```swift
func squares() {
    for value in 1..5 {
        yield value * value
    }
}

for value in squares() {
    print(fmt("square: {0}", value))
}
```

Run it with:

```powershell
dotnet .\bin\spk.dll .\Examples\Language\04-iterators.kit -nologo
```

Source: [04-iterators.kit](../Examples/Language/04-iterators.kit)

## Exceptions

Throws and catches an application error while keeping the script running.

```swift
func loadUser(name) {
    if name == "" {
        throw Exception<UserError>("A user name is required.")
    }

    name
}

try {
    loadUser("")
} catch error {
    print(fmt("[{0}] {1}", error.Name, error.Message))
}
```

Run it with:

```powershell
dotnet .\bin\spk.dll .\Examples\Language\05-exceptions.kit -nologo
```

Source: [05-exceptions.kit](../Examples/Language/05-exceptions.kit)
